title: The Math of Leverage: How Debt Wipes People Out

beats.say: A 20% drop in price can instantly wipe out 100% of your wealth.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a house key sitting on a dark wooden table, soft dramatic lighting.

beats.say: Here's the exact math of how leverage quietly builds massive empires and suddenly bankrupts them.
beats.visual: Wide shot of a modern glass skyscraper reflecting a stormy grey sky.

beats.say: Say you buy a $100,000 property. You put down $20,000 and borrow the other $80,000.
beats.visual: Hand placing a stack of hundred-dollar bills onto a dark stone countertop.

beats.say: That's 5x leverage, meaning you control a massive asset with a very small deposit.
beats.visual: Overhead shot of a clean blueprint layout of a residential house.

beats.say: If the market goes up 20%, the property is now worth $120,000.
beats.visual: A clean white model house sitting on a polished reflective surface, bright overhead light.

beats.say: You just doubled your $20,000 investment, turning a small win into a massive victory.
beats.visual: A person's hands in shadows opening a heavy, empty leather folder on a desk.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about the dark side of using borrowed money.
beats.visual: Close-up of a pen resting on a blank contract, side lighting casting a long shadow.

beats.say: If the property value drops by 20%, your entire $20,000 down payment is completely gone.
beats.visual: A weathered brick wall with a faint shadow of a person walking away.

beats.say: The bank still wants their $80,000, and you're left holding a completely empty pocket.
beats.visual: An empty concrete parking lot of a commercial building at dusk, single streetlight on.

beats.say: This double-edged sword is why even famous real estate gurus have faced massive corporate bankruptcies.
beats.visual: Close-up of a vintage brass scale tipping heavily to one side on a dark desk.

beats.say: This week, calculate the leverage on your own home or any asset you want to buy.
beats.visual: A person's hand typing numbers on an old-school silver calculator, soft focus.

beats.say: If your total debt is more than 80% of the asset's value, you're in danger.
beats.visual: A simple red line graph on a piece of paper, showing a sharp downward trend, no text.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, and protect your downside because...
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing by a large office window looking out at a quiet city skyline at night.

caption: Leverage is a double-edged sword that can build fortunes or wipe you out overnight. Here's the brutal math. #money #personalfinance #leverage #debt #wealthbuilding
description: Learn how 5x leverage turns a small 20% price gain into a 100% return, and how a 20% drop completely destroys your initial investment. Protect your downside by tracking your debt-to-asset ratio.
first_comment: Have you ever calculated the exact leverage on your home or investments? Let us know below.

facts.claim: A $100,000 property bought with $20,000 down represents 5x leverage, where a 20% drop wipes out equity and a 20% rise doubles it.
facts.basis: Standard mathematical formula for leverage: $100,000 total value divided by $20,000 equity equals 5x leverage. A 20% fluctuation of $100,000 is $20,000, representing 100% of the equity.

facts.claim: Famous real estate gurus have faced massive corporate bankruptcies.
facts.basis: Robert Kiyosaki's company Rich Global LLC filed for bankruptcy protection in 2012.
